lines.2: Damn it. Guess I'll have to handle this myself.
lines.4: 「That girl went up to the roof, Leo.」
lines.6: 「You're a bigger chicken than you look. Figured you might be scared stiff of one girl, so I came as backup.」
lines.8: 「...I'm glad you came, but I can handle this on my own.」
lines.9: 「Then again, I'd feel uneasy if you left.」
lines.10: 「Demanding little bastard, aren't you? Fine, I'll wait here.」
lines.11: I leave Subaru behind and head onto the roof.
lines.13: Just as expected, she is there alone.
lines.16: 「Are you the man I slapped yesterday for refusing to take no for an answer?」
lines.18: Wait, so she casually hits people too?
lines.19: Though she certainly looks like the violent type.
lines.20: 「I'm Tsushima Leo. We met here yesterday.」
